svg.title: Make room. Then drain.
svg.desc: Trace the lifecycle from a new Pod to readiness, Service routing and bounded shutdown of the old Pod. Illustrative flow, not live telemetry.

g.text: A rolling update designed to keep serving

g.text: Readiness controls routing. Liveness stays independent.
A design sequence, not proof of uninterrupted availability in a live cluster.
